name: Exterior Masonry Alkali-Resistant Primer
intent: Alkali-resistant primer mandatory on ALL new masonry (pH 12-14). Spray+backroll primary, roll fallback, brush detail.
doctrine: Alkali-resistant primer mandatory on ALL new masonry. Backroll forces primer into porous surface for continuous film. Spray-only PROHIBITED on porous masonry. Substrate type modifier applies.
